scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @clinicos/shared-types run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @clinicos/api --filter @clinicos/web run dev
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @clinicos/api run type-check && pnpm --filter @clinicos/web run type-check && pnpm --filter @clinicos/shared-types run type-check
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @clinicos/database exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @clinicos/database exec prisma db seed --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter @clinicos/database exec prisma migrate reset --force --schema prisma/schema.prisma
